name: PREMIER MARTIAL ARTS DUBAI (Ibn Battuta, Discovery Gardens)
address: Ibn Battuta Gate Building - 503A 5th Floor - Jabal Ali First - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description:
Premier Martial Arts (PMA), an esteemed karate club affiliated with JSKA, one of the largest karate associations in the world and Approved by the UAE Karate Federation and General Authority of Sports, PMA offers unparalleled training and a supportive environment for individuals of all ages. Our experienced and certified coaches are dedicated to elevating your skills to new heights. We take immense pride in developing talented individuals and consistently send our students to national level championships, where they achieve remarkable success, often securing first-place victories.

reviews.author: Ajitha Vinukumar
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Premier Martial Arts in Jebel Ali, Dubai. The coaches are professional, patient, and genuinely focused on helping students improve step by step.

The karate classes are well structured, with strong attention to discipline, confidence, fitness, technique, and overall development. The training environment is friendly but disciplined, which makes it suitable for both kids and adults.

If you are looking for quality karate classes in Dubai, especially around Jebel Ali, Discovery Gardens, Ibn Battuta, or nearby areas, Premier Martial Arts is definitely worth considering.

A professional martial arts academy with experienced coaches, structured Shotokan Karate training, and a positive learning environment. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Ganga Raj
reviews.text: My experience with Premier Martial Arts was great! Coach Midhun is excellent, very supportive, and pays individual attention to students. As an adult starting out karate, he made sure the journey and progress is not boring, yet making sure we get the basics right, and make progress without pressure and strain. Other coaches are great and pay attention to individual students too ! I will recommend premier martial arts to more people looking to learn karate with a good foundation.

reviews.author: Coach Karate
reviews.text:
Premier Martial Arts Club is one of the best karate clubs in the Ibn Battuta Gate, The Gardens, Discovery Gardens, and Marina areas. The training is highly professional while remaining engaging for all age groups.

Sensei Midhun explains techniques clearly and ensures students understand proper form and safety. The dojo maintains a disciplined, positive, and family-friendly environment.

Training is structured and adapted to individual fitness levels, with consistent encouragement throughout.

Posting this review as a fellow coach with experience in youth and adult sports training.

reviews.author: ManjuManohar jwel
reviews.text: My son have been talking training at PREMIER for more than a year and it’s hands down one of the best decisions I’ve made. The instructors are certified, patient, and really focus on technique, safety, and respect — the core values of karate. Classes are well-structured for all levels, from beginners to advanced. We felt very huge improvement on him not just in skill, but in confidence and fitness also. Highly recommend for anyone looking to start or deepen their karate journey! 🥋💪

reviews.author: SG786
reviews.text: A wonderful karate class and teachers that teaches children discipline, confidence, focus, and respect in a fun and positive environment. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Aby S.
reviews.text:
I first enrolled my son in Premier Martial Arts when he was 4 years old, last year, for just 2 months. After 6 months, during the school break this year, I asked him what he wanted to do for the summer. Without a second thought, he said, “I want my karate classes again.” He re-enrolled mid this year as a white belt, and now he is currently holding a yellow belt.

I can definitely recommend this activity for your kids. The instructors (senseis) are very professional and easy to talk to. They dedicate quality time to each child to ensure they are improving. I’ve noticed that my son has become more sociable, focused and disciplined.

Thank you, Premier Martial Arts. See you again during winter break!

reviews.author: Pallavi Rai
reviews.text: I’ve been bringing my 7-year-old here, and I’m really happy with the gradual but steady improvement I’ve seen in him. The instructors are patient, encouraging, and truly understand how to work with young kids. They focus not just on technique, but also on confidence, discipline, and respect. Highly recommend this academy to any parent looking for a positive and supportive martial arts environment.

reviews.author: Yonna Sharma
reviews.text: I have been coming since 3-4 years now and this club is excellent when it comes to improving their students. I am now brown 1 and I hope to get black soon.

reviews.author: Abdul Nazar
reviews.text:
It is very good place to learn karate.Coach midhun is very dedicated,sincere,and pays close attention to every student’s progress. Only a little strict about giving belts, but it motivates students to train properly and improve their skills
A great environment for both kids and adults
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you very much for your kind and encouraging feedback. We truly appreciate your support and trust in our academy. Regarding belt progression, junior belts follow a smooth and timely process based on attendance and performance. Senior belts have stricter requirements, as we believe belts should be earned through consistent training, discipline, and skill development. This approach helps students value karate, follow its ethics, and grow both physically and mentally. Thank you once again for being part of our karate family.

reviews.author: marian mamdouh
reviews.text: kids will enjoy the training. The center is certified , different available times slots among the week, which is an important advantage.The coach is welcoming, and patient with kids.

reviews.author: aadithya!
reviews.text:
The dojo is very quaint but lively. The master is very understanding and helpful in any issues and the teaching environment is very homely.

The karate itself is fun to master, with the occasional feeling of limb death, but, you get used to that.

The coach is very professional and fun, and in truth, he is probably the best karate teacher in business.

reviews.author: subin kp
reviews.text:
PREMIER is an amazing institute that i ever experienced
My son have been taking training at PREMIER for over a year, and it’s been a game-changer. The instructors are certified, patient, and focus on technique, safety, and respect — the core values of karate.
The facility is clean, well-equipped, and the schedule is flexible for working professionals. I’ve seen huge improvement for my son not just in skill, but in confidence and fitness. Highly recommend for anyone looking to start or deepen their karate journey! 🥋

reviews.author: jananii
reviews.text: Great karate class. The senseis explain every movement in great detail. They explain what the students are doing wrong and correct them in an interactive way. Students have a lot of fun while learning karate here. Definitely recommended to join

reviews.author: JAIN
reviews.text: I’ve had a really good experience at Premier Martial Arts. The instructors are patient, professional, and genuinely care about helping students improve, both in skill and confidence. Classes are well-structured and welcoming for beginners, but still challenging as you progress. The environment is positive and respectful, which makes it easy to stay motivated and consistent. I’ve noticed real improvement since starting and would recommend it to anyone looking for quality martial arts training.

reviews.author: Ali Boukhalfa
reviews.text:
Extremely pleased with this club that my son (5yo) and daughter (7yo) are a part of. The masters at this club have done an exceptional job in instilling good values and teachings in the students. They emphasize the importance of discipline, respect, and perseverance, not only in their karate practice but also in their everyday lives. They are supporting true values of martial arts.

The instructors are dedicated, patient, and positive role models who truly care about the development and well-being of their students. My children are happy and motivated to train 2-3 times a week and I am convinced it will help them not only gain physical strengh and balance but also grow as individuals with strong character values.

reviews.author: VINITH K L
reviews.text: One of the best karate schools in the area. The teaching style is very professional and at the same time enjoyable. I joined for fitness but ended up loving the karate practice as well

reviews.author: Anwer Sylesh
reviews.text: Premier Martial Arts Club has truly been a wonderful experience for both of our kids, who have completed nearly a year in this institution. The coaching staff and management team are very friendly and accommodating. Under the guidance of Master Midhun, we've noticed positive development in our kids. He explains karate techniques in a very kid-friendly and jovial way, making it easy for them to understand and grasp quickly. The team genuinely cares about each child's well-being and progress. Our kids love going there, not just learning martial arts skills but also gaining valuable lessons in discipline and self-confidence. We highly recommend it to parents seeking a supportive and enriching karate experience for their children. Thank you, Premier Martial Arts, and Master Midhun! 🙏🏻
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you for your positive feedback! We're delighted your children are thriving at Premier Martial Arts Club with Master Midhun. We appreciate your trust and look forward to their continued progress.

reviews.author: Nature Wanderers
reviews.text:
My two kids have been attending the classes for a few months and love them!

The teacher is very experienced and patient. Groups are kept small so students can receive individual attention and he makes sure to make the sessions enjoyable.

As a parent, I’m happy to see my kids learning new things and  also that they understand not only the hows but also the whys of what they’re being taught.

Karate shouldn’t be about aimlessly repeating the same drills day in, day out. It’s not easy to find a teacher who takes the time to explain the reasons behind the exercises, specially with younger kids.

I’m grateful we found the right place!

reviews.author: Priyanka Chalakwala
reviews.text: I enrolled my child in this karate club, and I couldn't be happier with the results. The instructors have a remarkable ability to connect with kids and create a positive learning environment. My child's confidence and self-discipline have significantly improved, thanks to the guidance and support received here. I highly recommend this club for families looking to instill valuable life skills in their children.

reviews.author: Suvidha Shetty Rai
reviews.text: My son has been learning karate here for last one and half years. Must say his discipline and focus has improved a lot with the training and attention given. The trainers are doing an excellent job, loud shout out for Midhun Sir!

reviews.author: jaiii 03
reviews.text: I've been a member of this karate club for over a year now, and I can confidently say it's been a life-changing experience. The instructors are not only great teachers but also mentors who genuinely care about the growth and development of their students. The training sessions are challenging yet fun, and I always leave feeling motivated and empowered.

reviews.author: Piyush Rathod
reviews.text: Excellent karate club! The instructors are highly skilled and knowledgeable, providing top-notch training to students of all ages and skill levels. The club has a friendly and welcoming atmosphere, making it a great place to learn and improve your martial arts skills.

reviews.author: Lutfi Tawfiq
reviews.text:
Great place to learn karate.

Kids have been attending classes for over a year and are very happy. I can see how much they’ve learnt.

Experienced teachers and great atmosphere.

Registered with JSKA, providing an official certificate of rank, which is an advantage should we have to move Emirates/ countries.

I’d definitely recommend their classes.

reviews.author: Maria Mikaela dela Peña Carampatana
reviews.text:
It has been only a month since we started our class and we already learn a lot.
Master Midhun is a professional, he motivates, encourage the students, and he is dedicated to teach us. He have so much patience to both kids and adults especially who don’t get the moves that fast. We’re glad we chose to be in this club for we are comfortable and the students are friendly. You are not only learning, but you are also enjoying at the same time bc he have fun techniques in teaching u the karate moves.

reviews.author: Kunal Shah
reviews.text: This karate club has a strong sense of community. The instructors and fellow members are supportive and encouraging, creating an inclusive and motivating atmosphere. Whether you're a seasoned martial artist or a complete novice, you'll feel welcomed and inspired to reach your full potential. I've made lasting friendships here and look forward to each training session.
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you for the great review! We're glad you had a positive experience at Premier Martial Arts. We appreciate your support as valued customers. We hope to continue serving you with excellence in the future. Thank you again!

reviews.author: Mitesh Mistry
reviews.text: Premier Martial Arts and their dedicated coach, Midhun, have transformed my child's confidence and discipline. The club offers a well-rounded curriculum that focuses not only on physical skills but also on character development. It's been a fantastic experience for our family!

reviews.author: Imran Khan
reviews.text: Very nice people who genuinely care about students’ development. Nowadays, education often feels like just another business, so it’s hard to find this kind of dedication. You might not get a warm welcome or flashy first impression, but over time, you’ll really appreciate their sincerity and support. Highly recommended for anyone serious about learning and growth.

reviews.author: satheesh p
reviews.text: Received the Black Belt. Proud to receive in the first batch of the institute itself. Professional Coaching along with fun filled environment is highly appreciated.

reviews.author: soumya aneesh

Weeks he started doing kathas and all, and I have noticed a drastic change on my both kids. They really enjoys going karate and leaves with smile 😊. This class is not just karate  ,they r teaching our children respect each other and respect themselves. We r very much impressed the way he guides and instruct . Thank u midhun master for being a good   instructor for my kids🙏

reviews.author: Manmohan Semwal
reviews.text: If you want a place where kids can learn real karate and also improve focus, this is it. The balance between tradition and modern training methods is excellent❤️
